<thought>Based on the ESI‑MS spectrum the most intense ion is at m/z 235.1395. Assuming this is the [M+H]⁺ ion, the neutral mass is ≈ 234.132 Da. The formula C₁₃H₁₈N₂O₂ has an exact monoisotopic mass of 234.1368 Da, giving an [M+H]⁺ of 235.1441 Da, which matches the observed ion within typical MS tolerance. Thus the molecular formula is C13H18N2O2.</thought>
<final_answer>C13H18N2O2</final_answer>
